# Vendored `omp-rpc`

`omp-rpc` is the official Rust client for [omp](https://omp.sh)'s RPC
protocol. It lives in the [oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)
repository under `sdk/rust/omp-rpc` and is **not** published to crates.io, so
it is copied here.

## Why a copy

- It is not on crates.io, so there is no released artifact to depend on.
- Pinning the source keeps builds reproducible and offline-friendly.
- The upstream repository is a large TypeScript monorepo; depending on it
  would pull the whole tree into the build.

## What changed

Only two things, both mechanical:

1. **The upstream `[workspace]` table was removed** from `Cargo.toml` so the
   crate can join omp-ui's workspace. `scripts/sync-vendor.sh` does this.
2. **Two Rust 1.88+ language/library features were rewritten** so the crate
   builds with Rust 1.87, the toolchain omp-ui targets:
   - `let` chains in `src/client.rs` became nested `if let` blocks;
   - `slice::as_chunks` in `src/frame.rs` became `chunks_exact` plus
     `remainder`.

   These live in `patches/rustc-1.87.patch` and are re-applied on every sync.

Nothing else was touched: `src/wire.rs` is the upstream generated file and is
byte-for-byte upstream.

## Refreshing

```sh
scripts/sync-vendor.sh          # from the default branch
scripts/sync-vendor.sh v18.12.3 # from a tag
```

The script downloads the upstream sources, drops the standalone workspace
table, and re-applies the compatibility patch. Run `cargo check` afterwards.

## Upgrading notes

`src/wire.rs` is generated by upstream from
`packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire/rpc-wire.schema.json` with
`bun run gen:rpc`. New omp releases can add commands, events and enum values;
the Rust types follow. The webview contract in `src/schema.ts` is omp-ui's own
and is unaffected by upstream churn.
